resources.string: Volume released through the anal canal
Volume remaining in the rectum: %1$s mL
Released volume (mL) = initial rectal volume (mL) × (release share ÷ 100). Remaining rectal volume (mL) = initial rectal volume (mL) − released volume (mL).

The rectum temporarily stores stool. The anal canal is the passage from the rectum to the anus, not a storage compartment. The release share is the percentage of the starting volume that passes through that outlet in the example. These made-up volumes and percentages are not normal ranges. The example does not model water absorption, pressure, or sphincter function, and is not medical advice.
